title: Data dictionary for measurements.csv

files.experiments.json: Experiment-level metadata: names, PSI IDs, descriptions, objectives, documented results, NASA links.
files.measurements.csv: All measurements from the five tables in long format (one row per test and variable), keyed by experiment_id and test_id.

measurements_csv.encoding: UTF-8, comma separated, header row, no BOM
measurements_csv.grain: One row per test x variable. Empty source cells produce no row, except PSI-102 samples 5-8, which get one 'not_recorded' row per variable.

columns.name: experiment_id
columns.description: PSI ID of the experiment (PSI-25, PSI-26, PSI-69, PSI-98, PSI-102). Joins to experiments.json.

columns.name: test_id
columns.description: Unique test key built as <experiment_id>-T<NNN>, numbered in source row order after excluding non-test records. Unique across the whole file.

columns.name: source_row
columns.description: Line number in the source CSV (header = line 1) for traceability.

columns.name: test_label
columns.description: Label used by the source: Test # (PSI-25, PSI-26), FLEX Identifier (PSI-69), Sample Number (PSI-98), Sample # (PSI-102). Not always unique (PSI-26, PSI-69 have repeats).

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Sample # where the source separates it from the test label (PSI-25, PSI-26 only).

columns.name: pi
columns.description: Principal investigator surname from the PI column (PSI-25 only).

columns.name: test_date
columns.description: Test date parsed from the source. Dates are kept as written, even when the year looks wrong; see test_note.
columns.missing: blank for PSI-98 and PSI-102 (no date in source)

columns.name: gmt_day_of_year
columns.description: The source column 'GMT' in PSI-25 and PSI-26 is the day of the year (it matches the date in all but 8 rows), not a clock time.

columns.name: test_time_gmt
columns.description: Clock time (GMT) from 'Test GMT' in PSI-69.
columns.missing: blank for other experiments and for one FLEX test (test 9) with no time

columns.name: material
columns.description: Fuel or sample material text from the source, with repeated spaces collapsed.

columns.name: variable
columns.description: Name of the measured or recorded quantity; see 'variables' below.

columns.name: value
columns.description: Cleaned numeric value; blank for text variables and for values that cannot be given as one number (see quality_flag).
columns.missing: blank when not numeric or not available

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Unit of value; blank for text variables.

columns.name: raw_value
columns.description: The cell exactly as in the source (trimmed). Use it when value is blank.

columns.name: quality_flag
columns.description: Semicolon-separated flags describing cleaning or doubts about the value; see quality_flags.

columns.name: test_note
columns.description: Test-level issue (repeated for each row of the test): date or GMT inconsistencies, duplicate labels, suspicious columns.

variables.description: Flow-restrictor setting recorded for the test (values 0, 1 or 2 in the data).
Free-text record of the fan display readings during the test (sequences, 'pot' values and notes).
variables.notes: Not parsed: sequences of readings are kept as written.

variables.description: Free-text record of the air display readings during the test.
variables.notes: Not parsed.

variables.description: Radiometer gain setting(s) used. The source header lists the possible gains 1000, 250, 50, 10; values such as '250>50>250' mean the gain was changed during the test.
variables.notes: Not parsed.

variables.description: Total number of frames shot in the test.
variables.notes: Some values are 'none', 'video' or free text.

variables.description: Calibrated oxygen concentration at the start of the test.
Calibrated oxygen concentration at the end of the test.
variables.notes: Values below 5 or above 25 are flagged suspect_value.

variables.description: Carbon dioxide concentration at the start of the test.
Carbon dioxide concentration at the end of the test.
Carbon monoxide concentration at the start of the test.
variables.notes: Small negative values (instrument baseline) are kept and flagged negative_value.

variables.description: Carbon monoxide concentration at the end of the test.
variables.notes: 'OR' / 'over' mean over range; '>500' is a lower bound. Raw text is in raw_value.

variables.description: Order in which the test was run.
variables.notes: Not unique: some numbers repeat in the source.

variables.description: Ambient pressure in the chamber at the start of the test.
variables.notes: One test has 0, flagged suspect_value.

variables.description: Initial mole fraction of oxygen (O2) in the ambient gas.
variables.notes: Source header says 'O'; read as O2.

PSI-69.source_column: O initial ambient composition; mole fraction

variables.description: Initial mole fraction of nitrogen (N2) in the ambient gas.
variables.notes: Source header says 'N'; read as N2.

PSI-69.source_column: N initial ambient composition; mole fraction

variables.description: Initial mole fraction of carbon dioxide (CO2) in the ambient gas.
variables.notes: Source header says 'CO'; read as CO2 because O2+N2+CO+He then sums to 1 (values up to 0.7 would be implausible for CO).

PSI-69.source_column: CO initial ambient composition; mole fraction

variables.description: Initial mole fraction of helium in the ambient gas.

PSI-69.source_column: He initial ambient composition; mole fraction

variables.description: Initial droplet diameter.
variables.notes: Empty or en dash when not available.

variables.description: Droplet diameter at which the visible flame went out.
variables.notes: Often missing (49 empty cells plus 28 en dashes in the source); 0 appears in some tests and is not defined in the table.

variables.description: Droplet burning rate.
variables.notes: Source header says 'Burning rate; mm'; read as mm^2/s because the values (0.05-1.06) are typical burning-rate constants.

variables.description: Burn time.
variables.notes: FLEX: a few values are approximate ('~6'). SAFFIRE-1: duration of the burn.

variables.description: How the FLEX test ended: Extinction, Disruption or Completion.
variables.notes: The table does not define these terms.

variables.description: Sample thickness as given in the table.
variables.notes: 0.37 looks large for a fabric; the original unit may be mm. Verify before use.

variables.description: Sample length as given in the table.
variables.notes: The NTRS abstract gives the sheet as 94 x 40.6 cm; length and width labels may be interchanged.

variables.description: Sample width as given in the table.
variables.notes: See sample_length_cm.

variables.description: Air flow speed.
variables.notes: Used by PSI-98 and PSI-102.

variables.description: Oxygen concentration during the burn.
variables.notes: Source gives '21.5 - 21.7' and '~ 21.5'; stored as midpoint 21.6 (range_midpoint) and 21.5 (approximate).

variables.description: Ignition power.
Ignition time.
Flame spread relative to the airflow: Concurrent or Opposed.
Identifier of the Camera 1 data set for the test.
variables.notes: An ID, not a measurement.

variables.description: Identifier of the Camera 2 data set for the test.
variables.notes: An ID, not a measurement.

variables.description: Sample weight loss rate.
variables.notes: Empty for samples 5-8.

variables.description: Smoke aging duration.
variables.notes: Empty for samples 5-8.

missing_value_conventions.treatment: No row is written for that variable; counted in 'empty_in_source' per variable.
value blank, flag reported_none (the source says the quantity was not available).
value blank, flag dash_in_source (34 cells; probably 'not available', meaning not defined in the table).
value blank, flag over_range (reading above the instrument range).
value blank, flag censored_greater_than; the bound is kept in raw_value.
value blank, flag video_only (frames not counted; recorded as video).

missing_value_conventions.source_value: Other text in numeric columns (e.g. '300+ +102', '10 postburn only')

quality_flags.dash_in_source: Source has an en dash instead of a value.
quality_flags.censored_greater_than: Value only known as 'greater than' a bound.
quality_flags.video_only: Source says 'video' instead of a frame count.
quality_flags.range_midpoint: Source gives a range; value is its midpoint.
quality_flags.non_numeric: Free text in a numeric column.
quality_flags.suspect_value: Physically implausible: O2 outside 5-25 % by volume (5 values in PSI-25) or ambient pressure of 0 mmHg (1 value in PSI-69). Kept unchanged.
quality_flags.negative_value: Negative CO reading, probably instrument baseline offset. Kept unchanged.
quality_flags.not_recorded: Variable has no value for this test (PSI-102 samples 5-8).

special_cases: PSI-26 source row 67 (SOOT Cleaning, 2012-08-03) and PSI-98 source rows 4-5 (pointers to pre-test flow-visualisation data) are not tests and are not in measurements.csv; they are listed under 'dataset.excluded_source_records' in experiments.json.
PSI-26 'As Run Test #' repeats (24, 85, 89-91 appear twice), and its Test # labels 53, 75, 114 and 118 each belong to two tests; test_id stays unique.
PSI-25 dates in 2016 (O20-O22) and 2018 (T9, T18) differ from the 2014 campaign; PSI-26 has a date in 2103; one PSI-26 date is malformed ('6/29/`12'). These are noted, not corrected.
PSI-25 B14 has inconsistent CO2/CO values (possible column shift); PSI-25 O10 has a GMT day that does not match its date.
PSI-69: 193F001 appears in tests 70 and 73 with the same date and time; six tests (69, 75, 76, 79, 80, 81) have initial mole fractions summing to 0.98.
Source file PSI-69 uses Windows-1252 encoding; all output is UTF-8.
